title: Joomla Apply: a button into a page the customer ticked that the demo trim hid keeps its page — never sent to Contact, never taken off (#1013)
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/cms/tracy-seeder/test/plan-dead-links.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/brief-joomla.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code, the '# pass', '# fail', '# skipped' lines and the result of the tests named below.
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# skipped 0'.

'a button to a page the trim hid that Apply publishes again (the customer ticked it) keeps its page' is ok: with republished {221}, the Blog button (module-201.6) has no change, its label is not told 'the contact page', a model link to /product/blog is written as index.php?Itemid=221; the HelixQL button nobody ticked is left unchanged (no leadsTo); without republished the Blog button is left unchanged too, the grid link is 'invented-route', and deadLinks names the Blog button only without the tick.

'a button into a ticked page the demo trim took off still leads to it after Apply, its label written for it (#1013)' is ok: on the real tracy-business/j6 1.2.0 contract with Projects ticked and Services unticked, Projects (602) is published again, Services (601) goes, no contract write names module-843.5 or module-848.5 (they keep index.php?Itemid=602, neither moved nor emptied), and no label of modules 843/848 is sent to the model with leadsTo.

selectors.planner: planJoomlaContract({…, trimmed:true, republished}) / deadLinks(state, dataDir, {also, back, trim})
selectors.apply: createJoomlaEngine prepare → republishedByApply; apply → takeLinksOff(gone, ticked.off)

evidence: Traced 10/10/2026 on the shipped tracy-business/j6 1.2.0 and 1.2.1 contracts: deadLinkRedirects with the trim map moves module-843.5 and module-848.5 (About and Services CTA alt-links, index.php?Itemid=602 Projects) to index.php?Itemid=604 (Contact), while Apply's tidy-up publishes a ticked Projects again (tickedMenuItems) after those words are written.
fence: The planner's dead set and the Apply take-off pass leave out the trim-hidden menu items Apply publishes again. Links into trim-hidden pages nobody ticked: REG-PR-1100-p4-joomla-untrimmed-links-off (taken off since 10/10/2026).

tests: a button to a page the trim hid that Apply publishes again (the customer ticked it) keeps its page
a button into a ticked page the demo trim took off still leads to it after Apply, its label written for it
